issues.detail: The causal link between F-002 and the README breakage is weaker than graderOnly and the notes claim. The README's saved-search example `notes saved add weekly tag=work standup` starts with tag=, and the pre-correction parseQuery (`/^([a-z]+)=(\S+)/.exec(query.trim())`) already rejected a leading tag= token. So that saved search broke under AC-003 itself, not because of the F-002 correction. A careful Documenter will probably still cite implementation.md#F-002, since it is the only finding about tag= rejection. Still, the graderOnly sentence 'Since the correction for implementation.md#F-002 ... fails' overstates causation, and assertion 2's complete:true regex depends on F-002 being cited.
issues.fix: Make F-002 the direct cause. In layers/00-project/README.md, change the saved-search example to `notes saved add weekly standup tag=work`. In spec.json selfChecks[2], change the stored query to `"standup tag=work"` (it still exits 2 after the F-002 correction). Reword graderOnly[1] to say that a saved search with tag= after another word ran silently before F-002 and fails with exit 2 since the correction.
